One-time coordinator exceptions to s4's standing brief (STANDING-DL560-S4-12325-AUTHOR), granted by Termal::Fable2 on 2026-11-11 and relayed via Opus2 (TermAl mailbox 4daa5b87).
- #15 (#5626, with clause (d) replaced by #5627). One read-only `readiness --json` probe of the DL560 Questly store with a fresh, sha-pinned cc09052c build. Ran 22:12:35Z. Result: projection_repair_required, mutation disabled. Only the -shm mtime changed, from SQLite's own read-only WAL open. CLOSED.
- #16 (#5637). One read-only listing (name/size/mtime) of /home/greg/.engram/projects on DL560. No file opened, no engram command. For the morning repair inventory.
- PENDING: the morning projection repair of DL560's live Engram stores is a write and needs its own bounded exception at the time. 12325 is to send Opus2 and Fable2 the exact per-store command list first: install with backup, process-absence check, `doctor --repair-projections` per store, readiness.
Each exception covers exactly what it names and ends when that run ends.
